page.title: Connectors
page.intro: Ikonekta la reng kekang advertising account. Deng lead ibat kareng kekang ads miraras la keng My Leads automatic, atin gastus ampo gastusan balang lead.

catalog.linkedinDescription: Lead Gen Form magdala ya keng My Leads, aldo-aldong gastusan ampo gastusan balang lead, ampo ing kalidad ning lead a mibalik keng LinkedIn ( Conversions API ).
catalog.notAvailable: Eku pa maka-set up kening server ayni

banner.connected: LinkedIn makakonekta ya. Deng leads kukunan da la ngeni - ing page ayni mag update ya keng saglit.
banner.notConfigured: E ya pa maka-set up ing LinkedIn kening server a ini. Ing administrator kailangan yang idagdag ing client ID ning LinkedIn app ampo ing sikretu.
banner.expired: Ing LinkedIn connection me-expire ne, inya e la mag-sync deng leads. Magkonekta kang pasibayu para isundu.

connect.title: Connect LinkedIn
connect.intro: Mag-sign in ka keng LinkedIn account na mag-manage kareng kekang ads. Leadrat babasan nalamu reng kekang ad account, Lead Gen Form leads ampo ad statistics, ampo padala yang conversions a kekang i-switch on.
connect.need1: Metung a papil keng LinkedIn ad account (Viewer o mas matas).
connect.need2: Ing role keng makasuglung a bulung ning kumpanya (Administrator, Lead Gen Forms Manager , Content Admin , Curator o Analyst) - LinkedIn mangailangan yang magshare kareng leads.
connect.need3: Ing kutang keng number ning teleponu keng kekang Lead Gen Forms - deng lead a alang teleponu e la malyaring idagdag.

connection.reconnectBy: Mag sign in kang pasibayu by

connection.confirmDisconnect: Disconnect me LinkedIn ? Tutuknang ing pamag-sync at mebura la reng access tokens. Deng lead, statistics ampo ing activity log ila reng mitagan.
connection.noPermission: Malyari meng akit ing page ayni. Ing pamagkonekta ampo pamagbayu kareng settings kailangan ing "Manage Settings" a permission.
connection.fetchTitle: Manintun kang lead keng date range
connection.fetchHint: Deng bayung lead susuri da la balang mapilan a minutu ampo deng tauling 7 aldo susuri da lang pasibayu aldo-aldo, inya alang mawala. Gamitan me ini para kareng lead bayu ka mekonekta, o para akit meng pasibayu ing period (anggang 90 aldo keng metung a oras). Deng lead na atyu na keng Leadrat , laktawan da la.
connection.fetchResult: {{from}} - {{to}} : {{received}} meyakit ya, {{created}} megawa ya, {{duplicates}} duplicate, {{rejected}} rejected, {{skipped}} me-import ne.

capi.title: Conversions API
capi.intro: Sabyan mu LinkedIn nung ninu kareng leads na ing meging prospects. Potang ing metung a LinkedIn lead miras ya keng status a pinili mu keng lalam, i-report ne Leadrat keng LinkedIn , para ing kekang campaign reports magpakit yang kalidad ning lead ampo LinkedIn makatuknang yang mas dakal a taung kalupa da reng kekang pekamasanting a lead. Ing LinkedIn lead ID mu ampo ing one-way hash ning email ing mipadala.
capi.created: Ing pamagbayu megawa ya keng LinkedIn ampo me-map ya.

activity.title: Activity log
activity.intro: Ing sabla pilatan Leadrat ampo LinkedIn : koneksyun, balang pamag-sync, balang lead ampo nung nanu ing milyari kaya, pamagbayu ampo pamagkamali.
